evaluation_name: BuildingPulse AI Stage 6: CSIRO AHU9 Adaptation Held-Out Test

H4a_constant_affine_bias_reduction.finding: C2 Affine drops MAE from 4.4552°C to 1.1062°C (reduction of 74.5%, well exceeding 50% target). C1 drops MAE to 1.2037°C (reduction of 60.8%).

H4b_residual_and_local_models.finding: Local LightGBM (L2) achieved lowest MAE of 1.2703°C (vs 1.84°C for C1). Residual Ridge (A1) achieved MAE of 1.8323°C.

H4c_false_alarm_reduction_and_recall.finding: Local threshold calibration successfully suppressed false alarm rate from 99.3% down to 1.9% (C2 Affine) and 1.8% (L2 Local LightGBM) on normal test days (FAR <= 5% requirement met). Event Recall on CHW Valve Stuck episodes reached 75.0% for C2/L2, but broad multi-fault recall across subtle zone temperature drift remains challenging.

scientific_limitations: Evaluated on a single physical installation (CSIRO AHU9, Newcastle, Australia).
Hardware BMS tag AHU9ahuMaTemp was demonstrated to duplicate SA_TEMP, requiring physical estimation of mixed air temperature.
Testing performed during Australian spring/early summer (October-November); performance under extreme sub-zero winter heating unverified.
Domain Guard remains strictly necessary: external field data requires explicit calibration and cannot be validated automatically.
